body: Each player may Replace 1 {Town} with 2 {Explorer}. 1 {Fear} per player who does.
In each land with 2 or more {Explorer}, Destroy 1 {Explorer}/{Town} per 2 {Explorer}.
In each land with 2 or more {Explorer}, Destroy 1 Invader per 2 {Explorer}.

body: Skip all Explore Actions in lands with at least 2 {Dahan}.
Skip all Build Actions in lands where {Dahan} outnumber {Town}/{City} (including lands with no {Town}/{City}).
Skip Build Actions in lands with {Dahan}.

body: Lands with {Presence} have Defend 2. Each Spirit gains 1 Energy per {SacredSite} they have in lands with Invaders.
Each player chooses a different land. In each: Remove up to 2 Health worth of Invaders per {Presence}.
